subject: literacy
concept: Understanding a character's feelings and motivations based on their actions in a story
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student acts out a character's likely feeling based on a described action from a story
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a character's pictured expression to the story event that caused it
exercise.abstract: Student explains why a character felt or acted a certain way, using evidence from the text

misconception_flags: states a feeling without connecting it to any story evidence

interest_binding: story content generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
